title: Employment Authorization Document - basics
facts: Form I-765 is used by eligible categories to request employment authorization and/or an Employment Authorization Document.
Eligibility for an EAD depends on the applicant's immigration category; filing I-765 does not by itself create eligibility to work.
Some noncitizens are authorized to work incident to status and may not need an EAD as their underlying source of work authorization.
An EAD is different from lawful permanent resident status; a Green Card itself is evidence of permanent work authorization.
